cases.article: 2.2.1 OTA: coffee named, blend not named
cases.source_quotation_scope: Official CTR IX includes coffee in a named OTA row (5 µg/kg published for coffee). Coffee–chicory mixtures are not expressly identified in that same row.
cases.research_only_number: Coffee comparator: 5 µg/kg; UNAPPROVED for coffee–chicory.
cases.blocked_transfer: Never auto-apply the single-ingredient coffee OTA comparator to a composite marketed coffee–chicory mix.
next_required_originals: Manufacturer's signed coffee/chicory percent formula and marketed identity
Operative original Gazette OTA article and legal blend-scope determination
Accredited OTA method with coffee-chicory matrix and LOQ
Original representative lot CoA, QA/Legal signoff and disposition

cases.source_quotation_scope: CTR IX sets residue MRLs per named pesticide and food; examples use broad Fruits and explicitly named fruit crops with different analytes.
cases.blocked_transfer: Cannot assign a general fruit MRL to every frozen blend without a matched pesticide, constituent fruit and as-sold processed matrix.
next_required_originals: Species-by-species frozen fruit BOM with percentages and processing
Original currently operative individual pesticide-food clause
Finished sample basis, processing factor justification and pesticide panel
Accredited method/LOQ for mixture and original finished lot CoA

cases.source_quotation_scope: The published pesticide-food rows cannot establish that arrowroot starch or arrowroot flour is potato, cassava or cereal.
cases.blocked_transfer: Do not inherit a potato, cassava or cereal MRL merely because the material is a starch or tuber derivative.
next_required_originals: Actual botanical identity and clarified flour versus extracted starch grade
Original named pesticide-food article including processed commodity scope
Process and concentration factors and defined finished sampling basis
Accredited method/LOQ and original arrowroot lot CoA

cases.article: 2.3.1: individual Eggs MRL on shell-free basis
cases.source_quotation_scope: Some pesticide entries, including 2,4-D, expressly name Eggs with a shell-free basis; not every residue has an Eggs row.
cases.blocked_transfer: Do not adopt fresh-egg shell-free basis as a ready-made maximum for dried albumen, yolk or whole egg powder.
next_required_originals: Species and whether powder is whole, yolk or albumen; original dryness
Original each-pesticide Eggs article and sampling basis
Validated dehydration/mass-balance and any legal processing adjustments
Accredited dry-egg analyte scope, LOQ and representative-lot CoA

cases.article: 2.3.1: named Eggs MRL is not jar/brine matrix
cases.source_quotation_scope: Individual pesticide rows for Eggs do not automatically specify the sampled fraction of pickled eggs in brine.
cases.blocked_transfer: Do not treat egg fraction, pickling liquor and entire jar as identical legal analytical commodities.
next_required_originals: Packed SKU eggs/brine/spice BOM and as-sold fractions
Original named pesticide × food operative legal reference
Signed sampled fraction, method and processing factor decision
Accredited defined matrix method/LOQ and original pack-lot CoA

cases.source_quotation_scope: Published CTR IX antibiotic misuse provision specifically discusses honey production; royal jelly is not by definition honey.
cases.blocked_transfer: Do not transfer honey-specific antibiotic MRPLs to royal jelly solely because both are bee-derived.
next_required_originals: Authenticated marketed pure royal jelly or blend identity and origin
Original operative antibiotic/royal-jelly applicability or exclusion ruling
Named antibiotic metabolite panel and approved accredited royal-jelly method/LOQ
Apiary treatment evidence and representative lot CoA/disposition
